related.title: Falco：容器行為例外與訊號保留
related.titleEn: Falco: container behavior exceptions without losing signals
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付模板、參數、16個測試與兩個缺值反例的修正證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the template, parameters, sixteen tests and repair evidence for the two missing-field counterexamples.
related.difference: 記錄規則、巨集、事件來源及必要欄位，將合法維護與應調查事件分別標籤。
related.differenceEn: Record rules, macros, event source and required fields; label authorized maintenance separately from events requiring investigation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 測試通過率=與人工預期相符的判定/全部測試；測試覆蓋仍取決於案例品質。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 16個合成物件測試，14個符合預期，2個缺欄位案例被錯誤允許。 通過率14/16=87.5%。
降噪率=(原誤報−新誤報)/原誤報；需同時檢查真陽性是否保留。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成事件產生24筆警示，其中8筆應調查、16筆為已核准維護；窄例外可排除12筆維護。 誤報由16降4，降噪率75%；若8筆應調查全保留，precision由8/24升至8/12。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Test pass rate is decisions matching manual expectations divided by all tests; coverage still depends on fixture quality. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Sixteen synthetic object tests yield fourteen expected decisions; two missing-field cases are incorrectly allowed. Pass rate=14/16=87.5%.

Noise reduction=(old false positives−new false positives)/old false positives, alongside true-positive retention. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Synthetic events yield twenty-four alerts: eight investigable and sixteen approved maintenance; a narrow exception removes twelve maintenance alerts. False positives fall from sixteen to four, a 75% reduction; retaining all eight true positives raises precision from 8/24 to 8/12.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: STIX 2.1：指標有效期、撤銷與來源信心
related.titleEn: STIX 2.1: indicator validity, revocation and provenance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付模板、參數、16個測試與兩個缺值反例的修正證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the template, parameters, sixteen tests and repair evidence for the two missing-field counterexamples.
related.difference: 區分created、modified、valid_from、valid_until、revoked與confidence；記錄自己的使用政策而不混成一個時間。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish created, modified, valid_from, valid_until, revoked and confidence, documenting local use policy separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 測試通過率=與人工預期相符的判定/全部測試；測試覆蓋仍取決於案例品質。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 16個合成物件測試，14個符合預期，2個缺欄位案例被錯誤允許。 通過率14/16=87.5%。
可用集合=在有效時窗內且未撤銷且來源政策允許的指標；新近修改不會自動延長有效期。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 100個合成指標中70個在有效期內，這70個中5個已撤銷、另5個來源不符本地政策。 可用70−5−5=60個，即60%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Test pass rate is decisions matching manual expectations divided by all tests; coverage still depends on fixture quality. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Sixteen synthetic object tests yield fourteen expected decisions; two missing-field cases are incorrectly allowed. Pass rate=14/16=87.5%.

Usable indicators must be in their validity window, not revoked, and allowed by source policy; modification time does not automatically extend validity. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of one hundred synthetic indicators, seventy are within validity; five of those are revoked and another five fail local source policy. Usable count=70−5−5=60, or 60%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
